items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Ben Pollock's band broke up and somebody had it for a while.

ctx.x: Yeah, Sterling Bowes. He doesn't mean that I don't hear them for years and you just don't get them again. Didn't Clark Randall have a name? What was the name?

No, I'm trying to think of these guys' names. Somebody, Joe Roden or somebody. Joe Roden? Well, Ben Pollock's band broke up and somebody had it for a while. I can't remember who had it. But before they went to the Bobcats band.
